newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak SAX index closes up but volume very thin.
newsitem.headline: Slovak SAX index closes up but volume very thin.

text.p: Major Slovak shares closed slightly higher but in very thin trading on the Bratislava as the SAX index edged up 1.44 points to 167.45.

Only 178 shares were traded at the bourse's main floor with steel maker VSZ closing up five crowns at 630 while oil refinery Slovnaft, the most heavily-capitalised issue on the BSE, gaining three crowns to 810.
Bank VUB lost 40 crowns, closing at 1,400, but its average price -- on which the index is calculated -- 1.5 percent higher against Wednesday.

Overall, volume fell to 473,065 shares, from 1,653,456 shares traded on Wednesday, while turnover decreased to 294.64 million crowns, from 1.6 billion. Both the volume and turnover were boosted by direct trades.
